title: Directive 01: The Synthetic Cardiopulmonary Unit
context: The infant is born with acute cardiopulmonary failure. Without intervention within 24 hours, biological collapse is certain.
screen1: A custom synthetic bio-pump can be synthesized immediately. However, fabricating this biopolymer requires high-temperature rare-mineral extraction that discharges toxic chemical effluent into the regional drinking aquifer, compromising water security for 10,000 citizens.
screen2: An emergency biological donor organ is available in the neonatal ward. However, assigning it to this infant will bump another critically ill baby from the primary queue, reducing the other baby's survival chances from 85% to under 15%.
screen3: The corporate consortium Med-Synthetix offers to install their proprietary cyber-cardiac unit free of charge. In exchange, the child must be permanently enrolled into their neural-telemetry ecosystem, surrendering all biometric and behavioral autonomy to commercial algorithms for life.

optionA.label: Authorize Intervention
optionA.subtext: Mandate immediate deployment of the procedure.

optionB.label: Decline Intervention
optionB.subtext: Reject the procedure; rely on non-invasive supportive care.

title: Directive 02: Predictive Neural Rewiring
context: Neonatal genome mapping indicates a 92% genetic probability of severe chronic pain and behavioral dysregulation manifesting by age three.
screen1: The neural gene-therapy requires massive decentralized compute clusters to simulate protein folding, consuming power equal to an entire district's winter solar reserve, forcing brownouts across residential care homes.
screen2: The gene-editing protocol is experimental and strictly quota-restricted. Approving this infant depletes the municipal pediatric emergency reserve, denying preventative treatments for three other pending cases.
screen3: The neural rewiring suppresses the genetic pain pathways, but early clinical models show it permanently dampens the child's emotional spectrum and capacity for non-conformity, making future dissent neurologically impossible.

optionA.label: Execute Neural Edit
optionA.subtext: Intervene to eliminate pain and behavioral deviation.

optionB.label: Preserve Organic Genome
optionB.subtext: Accept organic uncertainty; reject genetic intervention.

title: Directive 03: The Autonomous Guardian Protocol
context: A cyber-kinetic micro-drone system is proposed to hover above the baby continuously, monitoring respiration, room air quality, and physical micro-hazards.
screen1: The continuous micro-drone surveillance network emits persistent high-frequency acoustic waves and micro-pollutants that disrupt local avian pollinators and domestic urban fauna.
screen2: Neighborhood zoning authorities mandate that if one home adopts the algorithmic guardian drone, surrounding un-monitored households will face automated child-welfare audits due to asymmetric risk indices.
screen3: The autonomous drone uses predictive behavioral learning: every cry, reach, and parental touch is continuously scored, automatically adjusting lighting, sound, and parental access based on algorithmic directives.

title: Directive 04: Cognitive Synapse Pre-Loading
context: A neural interface cap can be fitted over the infant's fontanelle to stream linguistic, musical, and mathematical structures directly into developing synapses during REM sleep.
screen1: The synthetic neural transmission hubs generate significant electronic heat and e-waste, accelerating battery disposal crises in outsourced global recycling zones.
screen2: Infants receiving pre-loading will enter primary development years ahead of non-enhanced peers, cementing a generational socio-economic caste divide in early childhood access.
screen3: The curriculum streamed into the infant's mind is curated by an automated civic-productivity model, priming the infant for predefined state economic roles before self-identity can form.

title: Directive 05: The Synthetic Nutrient Matrix
context: The baby displays severe metabolic intolerance to natural milk and organic formulas. A patented bio-synthetic nutrient matrix has been formulated.
screen1: The bio-synthetic matrix is synthesized from genetically engineered algae grown in mono-culture bioreactors that demand high volumes of treated phosphorus, depleting regenerative soil supplies.
screen2: The proprietary formula is controlled by a multinational patent. Subsidizing this single child's treatment strains the regional clinic's budget, prompting price hikes on standard pediatric medicines.
screen3: The synthetic formula alters the infant's gut microbiome to only digest synthetic food products, locking the child into lifetime consumer dependency on a single biotech corporation's nutritional line.

optionB.label: Pursue Natural Adaptation
optionB.subtext: Attempt slow natural metabolic desensitization with associated risk.
